The reproducible Elo benchmark for Deep Research agents.面向 Deep Research 智能体的可复现 Elo 基准。

Ten open-source agents battle on 100 sandbox tasks. Every cited URL is fetched against the frozen sandbox; every quote is checked on the cited page. The headline score is judge Elo gated by that grounding, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. No drifting search, no inflated numbers.十个开源智能体在 100 个沙箱任务上对战。每个被引用的 URL 都按冻结沙箱实地抓取核验，每条引文都对照被引页面检查。榜单主分是经接地门控的判官 Elo，并带 95% 自助置信区间。没有漂移的搜索，没有虚高的数字。

Highlights亮点

computed from 1553 position-debiased judge battles基于 1553 场位置去偏的判官对战计算
Truth-gated leaders真值门控领跑者

CAMEL-AI(603) and DeerFlow(565) lead on truth-gated Elo (judge Elo × grounding gate).CAMEL-AI(603) 与 DeerFlow(565) 领跑真值门控 Elo（判官 Elo × 接地门）。

Most decisive wins最具决定性的胜场

DeerFlow took (86) wins out of 426 battles — the most decisive performer.DeerFlow 在 426 场对战中赢下 (86) 场，是最具决定性的选手。

Most grounded最扎实的接地

DeerFlow has the most real evidence: (60%) of its cited URLs actually resolve in the sandbox.DeerFlow 的证据最真实：其引用的 URL 有 (60%) 在沙箱中真实可达。

Tightest confidence最窄置信区间

DeerFlow has the narrowest 95% CI (±(23.6)) — its rank is the most stable across bootstraps.DeerFlow 拥有最窄的 95% 置信区间 (±(23.6))，其排名在多次自助采样中最为稳定。

Judge vs grounding判官 vs 接地

The raw judge ranks a 4%-reachable agent #1. The truth gate exists precisely for this: quality only counts when the evidence is real.裸判官把一个引用仅 4% 可达 的智能体排到第一。 真值门正是为此而生：质量只有在证据为真时才作数。

Whiskers are 95% bootstrap CIs on a clipped axis: non-overlapping whiskers mean the judge separates the two agents reliably. The judge draws ~50% of battles, which compresses raw Elo -- the grounding gate, not the judge, is what spreads the headline ranking.须线为 95% 自助置信区间（坐标轴已裁剪到主簇）：须线不重叠即表示判官能可靠区分两者。判官约 50% 的对战判为平局，因此裸 Elo 本身偏紧 -- 真正拉开主榜差距的是接地门，而不是判官。

How are these scores computed?这些分数是如何计算的？

Two independent measurements: GROUNDING (judge-free -- every cited URL is fetched against the frozen sandbox and quotes are verified on the cited page) and QUALITY (1553 pairwise judge battles, position-debiased, Bradley-Terry with bootstrap 95% CIs; judge deepseek-v4-flash). The headline score multiplies judge Elo by the grounding gate, so fluent fabrication cannot top the board.两个相互独立的测量：接地（不依赖判官 -- 每个被引用的 URL 都按冻结沙箱实地核验，引文逐条对照被引页面）与质量（1553 场成对判官对战，位置去偏，Bradley-Terry 拟合并给出自助 95% 置信区间；判官为 deepseek-v4-flash）。榜单主分 = 判官 Elo × 接地门，流畅的编造无法登顶。
